lessons.titleEn: one foot in freshness and the other in convenience
lessons.titleZh: 一邊重鮮度一邊重方便

target.pattern: \bone foot in freshness and the other in convenience\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Our menu has one foot in freshness and the other in convenience.
sources.expression: one foot in freshness and the other in convenience

brief.meaningEn: Combine an emphasis on fresh food with the ease of convenient preparation, using an image of standing in two areas.
brief.meaningZh: 用雙腳分站兩處的意象，形容同時重視食物鮮度與準備方便。
brief.grammar: have/keep one foot in freshness and the other in convenience; explain how each element appears in the food or approach.
brief.register: Creative balanced-position metaphor, not a fixed food idiom. Freshness is not automatically the same as tradition or a nutritional judgement.
brief.boundaryZh: 兼顧兩面不表示比例相等、每項食材都現做或必然健康；需有具體做法。
brief.misconceptionZh: 把現成部分與新鮮部分說清，不讓意象掩蓋實際資料。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述結合兩種需要的方法，保留來源及製作界線。

options.en: Freshly cut vegetables are combined with a prepared base whose use is stated.
options.zh: 現切蔬菜配預製湯底，並清楚交代。

options.en: The menu claims the whole soup is made from scratch at the table.
options.zh: 餐單聲稱整份湯都在桌旁由原料現做。

options.en: Only a prepared base is served, with no freshly cut addition.
options.zh: 只供預製湯底，沒加入現切食材。

options.en: The vegetables are described as decoration that is not included in the meal.
options.zh: 蔬菜被描述為不屬餐點的裝飾。

listening.explanationZh: 現切與預製各有對應，意象不能改成全部現做或沒有新鮮部分。
listening.en: Our lunch menu has one foot in freshness and the other in convenience: we add freshly cut vegetables to a prepared soup base, and the menu explains both parts.
listening.zh: 午餐餐單一邊重鮮度、一邊重方便：我們把現切蔬菜加入預製湯底，餐單清楚交代兩部分。

reply.promptEn: How does your lunch approach combine freshness with convenience?
reply.promptZh: 你們的午餐做法怎樣結合鮮度與方便？

options.en: We use fresh-cut vegetables together with a prepared base.
options.zh: 我們用現切蔬菜配預製湯底。

options.en: The menu has one foot in freshness and the other in convenience, with fresh vegetables and a prepared base.
options.zh: 餐單以新鮮蔬菜及預製湯底，一邊重鮮度、一邊重方便。

options.en: The fresh addition and ready base serve different needs in the same meal.
options.zh: 新鮮加入部分與現成湯底，在同一餐照顧不同需要。

options.en: We combine the two approaches and tell diners what has been prepared already.
options.zh: 我們結合兩種做法，並向食客交代甚麼已預先做好。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說清兩面怎配，不用意象代替來源資料。

scene.promptZh: 家庭午餐把剛切的水果配現成三文治，想形容既有新鮮部分又節省準備，不稱全部現做。哪句合適？

options.en: The lunch has one foot in freshness and the other in convenience.
options.zh: 午餐一邊重鮮度、一邊重方便。

options.en: The meal was prepared entirely from raw ingredients at that moment.
options.zh: 全餐都在當時從原材料即做。

options.en: No part of the lunch involved freshly prepared food.
options.zh: 午餐沒有任何新鮮準備部分。

scene.explanationZh: 水果與現成三文治提供不同部分，不是全即做或全無新鮮部分。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由這個雙腳意象推斷？

options.en: The approach combines two different priorities.
options.zh: 做法結合兩個不同需要。

options.en: The two parts necessarily occupy exactly half of the meal each.
options.zh: 兩部分必定各佔全餐恰好一半。

options.en: The context should identify what supports each side.
options.zh: 情境應指出各面有甚麼實際依據。

contrast.explanationZh: 雙腳分站是兼顧意象，不是分量公式。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把預製湯底也寫成當場從原材料煮，你要介紹真實做法。哪句最好？

options.en: We have one foot in freshness and the other in convenience; let us name the fresh vegetables and the prepared base honestly.
options.zh: 我們一邊重鮮度、一邊重方便；如實說新鮮蔬菜與預製湯底吧。

options.en: Could we call the base freshly made just because we add vegetables?
options.zh: 只因加蔬菜，我們可稱湯底現做嗎？

options.en: So the whole soup was prepared beforehand, including the vegetables?
options.zh: 所以整份湯連蔬菜，都預先做好？

dialogue.explanationZh: 預製的是湯底，蔬菜現切加入；不能把全部說成現做，也不能把現切部分說成預製。

speaking.en: Our menu has one foot in freshness and the other in convenience, and we explain what each part involves.
speaking.zh: 餐單一邊重鮮度、一邊重方便，我們也說清各部分做法。
speaking.promptZh: 你想用具體資料支撐意象。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你編一本給初學者的食譜集，希望章節介紹清楚：每篇保留一項現時處理的新鮮食材，也容許一項現成配料，並標明所需步驟；不要把整本書宣稱為全由原材料現做。用一至兩句英文寫編輯方向。

examples.en: The recipe collection keeps one foot in freshness and the other in convenience, pairing a fresh ingredient with an openly named ready-made component. Each recipe will show which steps still need doing.
examples.zh: 食譜集一邊重鮮度、一邊重方便，配合新鮮食材與明說的現成部分；每篇會列仍需完成的步驟。

examples.en: I want the guide to have one foot in freshness and the other in convenience without calling every ingredient homemade. The introduction should explain the fresh preparation and the shortcut separately.
examples.zh: 我想指南一邊重鮮度、一邊重方便，不把每項食材都稱家製；引言應分開說新鮮準備與簡便做法。

writing.selfCheckZh: 寫編輯選材及標示步驟的方向，區分新鮮處理、現成部分與家製標示，不把兼顧變成營養保證。

takeaways.en: The picnic had one foot in freshness and the other in convenience, with fruit cut that morning beside ready-made sandwiches.
takeaways.zh: 野餐一邊重鮮度、一邊重方便，早上現切水果配現成三文治。

takeaways.en: Her recipe notes kept one foot in freshness and the other in convenience by identifying both fresh additions and prepared sauces.
takeaways.zh: 她的食譜筆記列明新鮮加入部分與預製醬汁，一邊重鮮度、一邊重方便。

sources.sentence: The café serves simple home-style meals.

brief.meaningEn: Meals prepared or presented in a familiar domestic cooking style, including when served commercially.
brief.meaningZh: 以熟悉的家常烹調風格製作或呈現的飯菜，也可以由店舖供應。
brief.grammar: home-style meals; a home-style meal; describe which details create that style.
brief.register: Natural food collocation. Home-style concerns style, while homemade concerns where/by whom something was made; they are not interchangeable facts.
brief.boundaryZh: 不自動表示在私人家中煮、特定傳統菜或特定營養；不同家庭風格也可不同。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要分開風格與來源，避免只憑名稱聲稱家製或普遍熟悉。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體菜式或呈現描述家常風格，保留來源資料。

options.en: The domestic style of the food, not preparation in a private home.
options.zh: 食物的家常風格，不是私人住宅製作。

options.en: A requirement that the owner cook the food at home before selling it.
options.zh: 要求店主在家煮好才出售。

options.en: A claim that the café does not prepare the food itself.
options.zh: 聲稱咖啡店不自行製作食物。

options.en: A description limited to formal tasting portions rather than the listed dishes.
options.zh: 只指正式品嘗份量，不是列出的菜。

listening.explanationZh: 風格與廚房來源分開，原句明說店內製作。
listening.en: The café serves home-style meals such as simple stews and rice dishes, all prepared in its own commercial kitchen rather than in the owner’s home.
listening.zh: 咖啡店供家常風格飯菜，如簡單燉菜及飯類，全在店內商業廚房做，不在店主家煮。

reply.promptEn: How can a café serve home-style meals from a commercial kitchen?
reply.promptZh: 咖啡店怎能在商業廚房供家常風格飯菜？

options.en: The phrase describes the style of cooking, not a private-home location.
options.zh: 說法描述烹調風格，不是私人住宅位置。

options.en: Home-style meals can use familiar domestic dishes while being made in the café.
options.zh: 家常風格飯菜可用熟悉家常菜式，同時在店內做。

options.en: Simple stews and rice dishes give the food a domestic character.
options.zh: 簡單燉菜及飯類，令食物有家常特色。

options.en: A commercial setting does not prevent food from having that familiar style.
options.zh: 商業場所不阻止食物具有那種熟悉風格。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都分清風格及地點，不以名稱冒充私人家製。

scene.promptZh: 餐單用home-style meals形容燉菜及飯類，另清楚列明店內烹調。哪個理解準確？

options.en: The food has a home-style character without being cooked in a private home.
options.zh: 食物有家常風格，卻不是私人家中製作。

options.en: The label establishes which family originally invented each dish.
options.zh: 標示確立每道菜最初由哪家發明。

options.en: The café brings in all the dishes from the owner’s house.
options.zh: 咖啡店所有菜都由店主家帶來。

scene.explanationZh: 列明烹調地點，不能由風格加出家族起源或住宅供應。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 home-style meals 得出？

options.en: The meals have a style associated with domestic cooking.
options.zh: 飯菜有與家庭烹調相關的風格。

options.en: The meals were definitely made in someone’s private home.
options.zh: 飯菜肯定在某人私人住宅做。

options.en: Further details can explain what makes the style familiar in context.
options.zh: 更多細節可解釋該情境的熟悉風格。

contrast.explanationZh: 風格名稱不確立實際製作地點。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想把店內做的home-style meals翻成店主家中煮好送來，但沒那個來源。哪句修訂較好？

options.en: Describe the home-style meals and keep the stated café-kitchen location.
options.zh: 描述家常風格飯菜，同時保留已說的店內廚房地點。

options.en: Does home-style mean the owner cooks these dishes at home and brings them to the café?
options.zh: 家常風格是否表示店主在家煮好這些菜，再帶到店？

options.en: Then the food cannot be described as familiar in style because it is sold.
options.zh: 那麼食物既出售，就不能形容風格熟悉。

dialogue.explanationZh: 家常描述風格，已說來源是店內廚房；不是住宅供應，也不因商售而不能有家常風格。

speaking.en: The café offers home-style meals, but the name describes their style rather than a private-home origin.
speaking.zh: 咖啡店供家常風格飯菜，但名稱描述風格，不是私人住宅來源。
speaking.promptZh: 你想分清家常與家製。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為社區共餐寫邀請，志願廚師在活動場地廚房煮簡單燉菜，大家圍坐共享；你想以家常風格傳達親切，但不說每位訪客都認識這些菜，或食物從私人家送來。用一至兩句英文寫邀請。

examples.en: Join us for home-style meals prepared in the community kitchen and shared around the table. The cooks will introduce the dishes for anyone who has not tried them before.
examples.zh: 歡迎來共餐，飯菜在社區廚房準備，以家常風格圍桌共享；廚師會向未嘗過的人介紹菜式。

examples.en: We will serve simple home-style meals prepared in the hall kitchen, with time to meet the cooks and ask about the dishes. Come and share the table, whether or not these dishes are familiar to you.
examples.zh: 我們會供應在大堂廚房準備的簡單家常風格飯菜，留時間認識廚師及問菜式。無論你是否熟悉這些菜，都歡迎圍桌共享。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以圍坐、介紹菜式及實際廚房資料寫邀請，不假定每人熟悉同一家庭風格，也不把家常等同私宅製作。

takeaways.en: The small dining room offered home-style meals and a chance to ask the cook about the day’s stew.
takeaways.zh: 小飯廳供家常風格飯菜，也讓人問廚師當天燉菜。

takeaways.en: The visitors recognised the home-style meal from the dishes they used to share with their relatives.
takeaways.zh: 訪客從以往與親人共享的菜式，認出這餐的家常風格。

sources.sentence: When time is short, convenience often wins the day.

brief.meaningEn: Prevail in a decision or argument, or become the factor that secures the outcome.
brief.meaningZh: 在決定或論辯中取勝，或成為促成結果的因素。
brief.grammar: a reason/argument wins the day; won in past; can refer to a winning factor rather than a literal day-long contest.
brief.register: Established idiom of prevailing or securing support. Here the reason that settles a choice wins the day; it is not a promise that all later outcomes succeed.
brief.boundaryZh: 說明某次選擇最後由甚麼主導，不表示其他因素無價值，或結果每方面最好。
brief.misconceptionZh: 分清決定因素、先有偏好及後來實際成果。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述比較後哪個理由取得支持，保留選擇範圍。

listening.promptZh: 哪個因素最後主導決定？

options.en: Being available on the agreed rehearsal dates.
options.zh: 議定排練日期有空。

options.en: The more impressive appearance of the distant venue.
options.zh: 遠處場地較出色的外觀。

options.en: The fact that the distant venue had already been booked for those dates.
options.zh: 遠處場地早已訂到那些日期。

options.en: A decision to change the rehearsal dates before comparing venues.
options.zh: 比較場地前，已決定改排練日期。

listening.explanationZh: but 後及only option 說明可訂日期促成選擇，不是先前吸引的外觀。
listening.en: The distant venue looked impressive, but the local hall’s availability won the day: it was the only option we could book for the agreed rehearsal dates.
listening.zh: 遠處場地看來出色，但本地大堂可用的時間最後取勝：它是唯一能訂到議定排練日期的選擇。

reply.promptEn: Why did the local hall win support despite the other venue’s appearance?
reply.promptZh: 另一場地外觀吸引，為甚麼本地大堂仍獲支持？

options.en: It could be booked for the dates the group had agreed.
options.zh: 它能訂到小組議定日期。

options.en: Its availability won the day because it was the only venue we could book for our agreed dates.
options.zh: 它是唯一能訂到議定日期的場地，所以可用時間最後取勝。

options.en: The booking requirement mattered more to this decision than the impressive setting.
options.zh: 這次決定，預約要求比出色環境重要。

options.en: The local option met the practical date constraint that the other one could not.
options.zh: 本地選擇符合實際日期限制，另一個不行。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都交代可訂日期的具體理由，不只說它勝出。

scene.promptZh: 兩個展覽提案都吸引，最後一份有清楚方法讓輪椅訪客參與，評選組因此選它。哪句貼切？

options.en: The clear access plan won the day in the selection.
options.zh: 清楚的參與安排在評選中最後取勝。

options.en: The selection was settled before anyone read the access plan.
options.zh: 沒人讀參與安排前，評選已定。

options.en: The group chose the other proposal because the access plan was missing.
options.zh: 小組因欠參與安排，選了另一提案。

scene.explanationZh: 因而選它，說明實際促成支持的因素。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 a reason won the day 得出？

options.en: The reason prevailed in the relevant choice or argument.
options.zh: 該理由在相關選擇或論辯中取勝。

options.en: The selected option is certain to succeed in every later respect.
options.zh: 所選方案日後每方面都肯定成功。

options.en: The context can show what competing consideration mattered less.
options.zh: 情境可說明哪個競爭考量較次要。

contrast.explanationZh: 當次取得支持不保證後來全部結果。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把大堂可訂日期取勝，寫成已證明觀眾最喜歡其外觀；觀眾還沒看。哪句較好？

options.en: Availability won the day in our booking decision; we have not measured the audience’s response to the setting.
options.zh: 可用時間在預約決定取勝；我們未量度觀眾對環境的反應。

options.en: Shall we describe the date requirement as the audience’s design preference?
options.zh: 我們把日期要求寫成觀眾的設計偏好，好嗎？

options.en: So the distant venue’s appearance was the main reason the group finally chose a place?
options.zh: 所以小組最後選場地，主要理由是遠處場地的外觀？

dialogue.explanationZh: 遠處外觀只是原先吸引點；最後是本地可訂日期取勝，不能改成外觀決定或未有的觀眾偏好。

speaking.en: The practical reason won the day in that decision, even though the other option had real strengths.
speaking.zh: 那次決定，實際理由最後取勝，即使另一選項確有優點。
speaking.promptZh: 你想指出決定因素並保留比較。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你與家人編舊相片故事，有人偏好流傳已久的日期說法，但一封有日期的原信及相片背字互相吻合，大家最後同意按證據修改。用一至兩句英文描述討論結果，不說證據永不需再查。

examples.en: The matching dates in the letter and photograph won the day, and we agreed to revise the family caption. We will keep a note of the sources we used.
examples.zh: 信與照片互相吻合的日期最後取勝，我們同意改家庭圖說；也會記下所用來源。

examples.en: In the end, the documented evidence won the day over the familiar version of the story. We changed the date while preserving the older account in our notes.
examples.zh: 最後，有文件支持的證據勝過熟悉的故事版本；我們改日期，同時在筆記保留較早說法。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以兩個來源吻合作當次取得支持的理由，寫修改與保留來源；不是因舊說法熟悉就優先，也不聲稱日後不用再查。

takeaways.en: The clearer explanation won the day when the group compared the two proposals.
takeaways.zh: 小組比較兩份提案時，較清楚的解釋最後取勝。

takeaways.en: Her account of the access problem won the day, and the organiser changed the entrance plan.
takeaways.zh: 她對進場問題的說明取得支持，主辦者改了入口安排。

brief.meaningEn: Ease or reduced effort often prevails over a competing intention or criterion in a choice.
brief.meaningZh: 在選擇中，容易或省事常勝過原有打算或另一項準則。
brief.grammar: convenience often wins when/after + circumstance; convenience won in a past choice. Often indicates a tendency, not every occasion.
brief.register: Transparent figurative use of win with an abstract subject; distinct from the fixed idiom win the day. Convenience does not literally compete in a sport.
brief.boundaryZh: 說哪種因素較常主導，不表示所有人都如此，也不自動判定該選擇好壞。
brief.misconceptionZh: 應指出與甚麼競爭及情境限制，不只把人物說成沒意志。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述偏好與實際選擇的落差，提出具體調整條件。

listening.promptZh: convenience often wins 描述甚麼？

options.en: Ease of preparation often outweighs the earlier elaborate plan after rehearsal.
options.zh: 排練後，準備容易常勝過早先講究計劃。

options.en: The saved recipe is followed whenever rehearsal ends.
options.zh: 每次排練結束，都跟存好的食譜。

options.en: The speaker chooses the more elaborate option because it needs more steps.
options.zh: 說話者因步驟較多，選更講究的方案。

options.en: The earlier plan was made only after the simple option had been prepared.
options.zh: 簡單方案準備好之後，才定較早計劃。

listening.explanationZh: 較少步驟與存好的講究食譜對照，often保留只是常見取捨。
listening.en: I plan an elaborate supper on quiet afternoons, but after a long rehearsal convenience often wins: I choose the option with fewer steps rather than the recipe I saved.
listening.zh: 安靜下午，我會計劃講究晚餐，但長排練後，便利常取勝：我選較少步驟的，不選存好的食譜。

reply.promptEn: Why does the meal you make differ from the one you planned?
reply.promptZh: 你實際做的餐，為甚麼與原計劃不同？

options.en: After rehearsal I prefer fewer steps to carrying out an elaborate recipe.
options.zh: 排練後，我寧願步驟少，不實行講究食譜。

options.en: Convenience often wins after rehearsal because I want fewer preparation steps when I get home late.
options.zh: 排練後便利常取勝，因晚回家時，我想少做準備步驟。

options.en: The effort involved matters more to me then than it did while planning.
options.zh: 那時所需投入，比我規劃時更影響決定。

options.en: My quiet-afternoon plan does not always fit the energy I have later.
options.zh: 安靜下午的計劃，不總配合之後的精力。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋規劃情境與實行時的差異，不用道德標籤代替原因。

scene.promptZh: 人物本想步行到遠一點、選擇較多的文具店，但下課趕車時常在校門小店買，因不用繞路。哪句貼切？

options.en: Convenience often wins when she has little time before the bus.
options.zh: 搭車前時間少時，便利常取勝。

options.en: She visits the distant shop because the detour takes longer.
options.zh: 她因繞路較久，選遠店。

options.en: Her purchases prove she dislikes the wider choice at the distant shop.
options.zh: 購買證明她不喜歡遠店較多的選擇。

scene.explanationZh: 省繞路時間主導當下，不證明她不喜歡較多選擇。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 convenience often wins 得出？

options.en: Ease frequently matters more than another consideration in the stated context.
options.zh: 所述情境中，容易常比另一考量重要。

options.en: The same factor determines every choice in every situation.
options.zh: 同一因素決定所有情況的每個選擇。

options.en: The account should identify the competing intention or criterion.
options.zh: 敘述應指出競爭的打算或準則。

contrast.explanationZh: often說傾向，不是無例外規則。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想把你排練後選簡單餐解作你從不喜歡煮食，但你安靜時仍享受較長食譜。哪句較好？

options.en: Convenience often wins after rehearsal, but I still enjoy cooking when I have the time and energy.
options.zh: 排練後便利常取勝，但有時間精力時，我仍享受煮食。

options.en: Shall we judge my interest in cooking only from the evenings when I get home late?
options.zh: 我們只按我晚回家的晚上，判斷煮食興趣，好嗎？

options.en: Then the elaborate afternoon plans must describe what I cook every night.
options.zh: 那麼下午的講究計劃，一定就是我每晚煮的。

dialogue.explanationZh: 把條件與興趣分開，既不一概否定，也不把原計劃當每晚事實。

speaking.en: Convenience often wins when the original plan does not fit the time I actually have.
speaking.zh: 原計劃不配合實際時間時，便利常取勝。
speaking.promptZh: 你想描述有條件的選擇傾向。先聽，再說。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你做讀者借書調查，受訪者偏愛大館選擇多，但平日趕接孩子時，常選近車站的小型取書點；你想提議讓預約書在那裏領取，配合實際行程，不推斷他們不愛閱讀。用一至兩句英文說明。

examples.en: Convenience often wins for readers who need to collect their children, even when they prefer the larger library’s choice. Letting them collect reserved books near the station could fit their routine.
examples.zh: 需接孩子的讀者，即使偏好大館選擇，便利仍常取勝；讓他們在近車站領預約書，可配合日程。

examples.en: The interviews suggest that convenience often wins when collection has to fit a busy journey. We should consider the station pickup point without treating it as a lack of interest in books.
examples.zh: 訪問顯示，取書需配合繁忙路程時，便利常取勝；應考慮車站取書點，不把它解作對書沒興趣。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以受訪者偏好與接孩子路程解釋取書選擇，提議服務安排，不將便利選擇當缺乏閱讀興趣。

takeaways.en: Convenience won when we chose the nearer pickup point despite preferring the larger library.
takeaways.zh: 即使偏好較大圖書館，我們選較近取書點時，便利取勝。

takeaways.en: In our weekday survey, convenience often wins over variety when readers have little time before collecting their children.
takeaways.zh: 平日調查中，讀者接孩子前時間少，便利常勝過選擇多樣。
